items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know. Did you know him?

ctx.x: Yeah, he had a trombone man.
But who was Buck Scott? That's the guy I wanted to ask you. Buck Scott, oh, wait a minute. Buck Scott, oh, he played later with Wayne, you know, before, I can't remember.
I don't know. Did you know him?
